name: Analogue bilateral switch
summary: Connects or disconnects an analogue signal path under its documented digital control.
description: Connects or disconnects an analogue signal path under its documented digital control.

On a schematic, identify the two signal terminals, supply rails and control active level and trace the switched analogue path and its reference limits. Keep the component tag and signal/reference names consistent across the control drawing, terminal schedule and device documentation.
Bilateral signal routing does not imply unrestricted voltage, current or galvanic isolation.

The preview is an independently drawn educational functional reference. Add the selected component’s actual power pins, terminal numbers, timing or analogue reference details when producing a construction drawing.
